LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_WarpFeather.label: Warp Feather Beckoning
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_WarpFeather.description: After a brief chant, invoke the Law of Matter to conjure 12–24 Milira feathers nearby. Of course, she might just be using the Law of Space or something like it to pluck feathers off another Milira. Cooldown: 300 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_ThunderMarkedStorm.label: Thunderseal Domain
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_ThunderMarkedStorm.description:
After a brief chant, invoke the Law of Psionics to mark units outside your faction in a selected area within 30 tiles. Line of sight is not required. Lightning strikes marked targets. The total number of strikes is fixed, so marking more targets means fewer strikes per target. Strikes are 0.75–1.25 seconds apart. Each deals 25 damage that ignores armor, applies EMP and sets flammable targets alight.
Thunder is one of nature's great powers and can drive out evil. It terrified Neiyu as a child. Now this is one of her favorite spells.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Bow_ArrowBarrage.label: Flowfeather Rend
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Bow_ArrowBarrage.description:
[Bow form required] Charge briefly, then fire a sustained barrage in the chosen direction. Each arrow deals 30 damage.
Neiyu was all thumbs when she first picked up a bow. Trying to infuse her arrows with Ji sent things a little out of control. The technique lets her lay down a lot of fire, though. Or so she says. It absolutely wasn't because she couldn't stop shooting.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Flower_BlessingField.label: Flower Array: Prayer of Life
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Flower_BlessingField.descriptio:
[Flower form required] After a brief chant, heal the wounds and old injuries of non-hostile flesh-and-blood targets in the selected area. The spell also lifts their mood and grants them a blessing. [Blessing] Movement speed +20%, incoming damage −10%, immunity gain speed +70%.
Neiyu was never good at arranging spell arrays, but a friend devoted herself to the art. With the Law of Life, the array could heal its targets. And since Neiyu held more Ji than any other Milira, this meant she could bring more of her kin home from battle...
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Flower_ToxinGarden.label: Flower Array: Miasma Garden
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Flower_ToxinGarden.description:
[Flower form required] After a brief chant, give enemies in the selected area food poisoning. Each has a 10% chance to go berserk.
Milira cooking has always been forbidden fare. Or poison, depending on who you ask. It's an array in name, with a dash of the Law of Time: every enemy gets a bite of the master chef's finest work. Here's to their good health.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Sword_Skyfall.label: Sword Art: Skyfall
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Sword_Skyfall.description:
[Sword form required] After a brief chant, strike enemies in the selected area with armor-ignoring damage. They become vulnerable and take 25% more damage.
The third sword art Neiyu learned from her master. A fast dive is enough to put the fear in an enemy, or to reach a whole crowd at once.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Sword_ExecuteHead.label: Sword Art: Beheading
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Sword_ExecuteHead.description:
[Sword form required] Charge briefly, then dash to a target's side and take off their head. If the target has no head, deal heavy damage that ignores armor instead.
The first sword art Neiyu learned, and the one that made her master famous. Hide the blade's edge until a single stroke will do. Once Neiyu mastered the Law of Space, the stroke could cut through space itself to reach its mark.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_WarpFeather.comps.CompAbilityEf: [Neiyu can't find room for the white feathers. Try casting somewhere with more space.]
